items.en: Türkiye and Saudi Arabia condemn Colombia's recognition of Israeli sovereignty over Golan Heights.

items.en: Trump claims US mine swept entire Strait of Hormuz.
items.he: טראמפ טוען שארה"ב סרקה מוקשים בכל מצר הורמוז.

items.en: IDF reported a missile launch, later identified as friendly fire.
